launch_owner: root, using scripts/run_simple_memory_cohort.py as the single bounded local supervisor

design.wave_policy: Start four seed-1 arms. Use their sustained frames/s and health to determine whether to proceed with the remaining fixed seeds; never select by favorable scientific outcome. At most eight simultaneous workers, with root as sole launcher.
design.frame_unit: Native environment physics frames; action_repeat=4. 1B frames =250M batched agent decision observations summed across environments.
design.minimum_throughput_contingency: First four fixed seed-1 arms must exceed 2M frames, pass finite/replay checks, and sustain >=11200 frames/s before more jobs start. Every run has a25.5h provider DELETE deadline. Allocation uses technical health only; no reward or ring result enters this decision.

hardware.alternate_plan_instruction: Replace the single --machine value with g2-standard-4; keep all scientific args and reservations unchanged. Use an explicit new name for a failed capacity attempt; never relaunch the same ledger name. Root must approve which hardware cohort is used; retain machine identity per run.
hardware.candidate_reason: Final source passed exact CUDA distribution/restart checks and two2M-frame throughput fixtures onT4. Final weights exactly matched the earlier implementation in both private fixtures.

package.manifest_status: Frozen exact source and protocol bytes
package.worker_log_nesting: Worker output is the parent of trainer seed directory, so worker.log does not violate the trainer fresh-output emptiness check. All trainer artifacts remain inside the uploaded tree.
